name: hyperdrain
changelog:
• IDM-Style Lightweight Mini-Window: Frameless, always-on-top 480x250 download progress popup with real-time download speed, percentage, ETA countdown, pause/resume/cancel controls, and instant folder navigation upon completion.
• Silent Background System Tray Mode: Closing the main window cleanly hides it to the Linux system tray without taskbar clutter while keeping high-speed engine downloads active.
• Zero-Touch Auto-Start Integration: Automatically registers on system boot/login and deep-link protocol (hyperdrain://wake) so you never have to manually open the application in the background to start downloading from your browser.
• Online Auto-Update & Uninterrupted High-Speed Core: Zero changes to the underlying Go download engine, preserving maximum 32-stream throughput, fallocate preallocation, and multi-track audio recovery.
